role: empirical-emulation extension of Model 3; does not modify frozen Model 3 results

biological_axes.pollen_limitation: log(supplemented viable maternal reproduction / natural viable maternal reproduction)

common_operator.source_immigrant_means: same stratum-specific founder means used for the focal pseudo-island

pseudo_islands.predictor: standardized log1p(distance) within the common five-point grid

fit.data: H1 all-analysis 4x3 domain slopes + H3 global pollen-limitation slope only
fit.domain_scale_rule: fit one nonnegative least-squares multiplier separately for assurance, accessibility and display_dulling across the four strata
fit.h3_rule: compare Model 3E pollen-limitation slope directly to 0.079368 because both are LRR responses against standardized log-distance
sign_gates: assurance isolation slope > 0 in all four strata
accessibility isolation slope > 0 in all four strata
fit.score: sum of three domain normalized RMSE values plus squared H3 error in empirical SE units
fit.prospective_acceptance: eligible parameter sets with total score <= 4.0; rank by score and freeze the best five without inspecting H2/H4

H2: within each stratum accessibility ~ standardized log-distance + assurance; compare isolation coefficient to frozen H2 accessibility_given_selfing
within each stratum display_dulling ~ standardized log-distance + assurance; compare isolation coefficient sign to frozen H2 plain_colour_given_selfing
held_out.H4: pooled pollen_limitation ~ standardized log-distance + stratum intercepts + assurance + accessibility; both trait coefficients must be negative to reproduce the held-out functional bridge
success_rule: at least 3 of 4 H2 accessibility_given_selfing signs are positive, including northern_high_latitude and tropical
held_out.no_retuning: search ranges, fit score, acceptance threshold and Model 3E operator cannot be changed after H2/H4 are opened in this screening

claim_boundary: This is a first empirical emulation, not a calibrated historical reconstruction of the four regions.
Display investment is a latent pollinator-facing axis; it is not literal pigment or colour category.
Stratum ecological contexts are generated from fixed seeds and a shared hyperprior rather than tuned to Chapter 1 regional outcomes.
A successful held-out H2/H4 test would show that one biologically explicit numerical world can reproduce key Chapter 1 domain-level relations, not that its parameter values are natural estimates.
